title: Kaset Satu Je
subject: a husband and wife in his 1992 Proton Saga whose cassette deck has eaten every tape except one P. Ramlee album, arguing on the drive to Ipoh over whether to finally buy a new radio
caption: Malay tango-cabaret in Argentine tango song style. Bandoneon playing sharp staccato phrases, string quartet with marcato chops and violin glissandi, tango piano with heavy marcato left hand, double bass on the strong beats. Dry theatrical room mix with close strings and sharp accents. Female mezzo and male baritone duet, theatrical half-spoken delivery trading lines. 118 BPM, D minor. Mock-serious comic standoff. No pop drums, no autotune, no EDM, no rock guitars, no reggaeton beat.
lyrics:
[Intro - bandoneon and marcato strings]

[Verse 1 - Female Vocal]
Lagu sama dari Rawang
Abang, tukarlah radio

[Verse 1 - Male Vocal]
Kaset ni masih hidup
Yang lain dia dah makan

[Chorus - Duet]
Kaset satu je
Sebelah A, sebelah B
Abang putar, saya tutup
Siapa nak mengalah dulu?

[Verse 2 - Female Vocal]
Pita tu dah berkedut
Suara P. Ramlee pun goyang

[Verse 2 - Male Vocal]
Lagu ni kita kahwin
Awak yang pilih dulu

[Chorus - Duet]
Kaset satu je
Sebelah A, sebelah B
Sampai Ipoh, awak nyanyi
Hafal semua, tak salah satu

[Outro - bandoneon final stab]
